release_condition: Parent acceptance of R2C2, then parent stage instruction; do not ask the human again for routine authorized training. No automatic launch from this proposal.

data.sampling: same frozen80percent moving/20percent other; same letter/family/category/window queues

model_and_objective.objective: unchanged native H1 phase-two residual MSE
model_and_objective.input: 4 real RGB history plus H1 target and4 normalized actual actions for training

learning_rate.kind: CosineAnnealingLR unchanged through completed update3000, then hold eta_min
learning_rate.update_u_uses_lr: optimizer update u uses L(u-1); successful completion advances scheduler to L(u), only if u<=3000
learning_rate.after_3000: Do not call cosine scheduler.step beyond last_epoch3000; leave optimizer groups at eta_min; store hold phase and true completed update counter separately. Do not reset warmup or silently rebuild scheduler.
learning_rate.skipped_update: No completed-update increment and no scheduler.step for an AMP-skipped optimizer update. Charge attempt and report/stop for parent review, no silent retry.

fixed_loss.noise_seed_domain: canonical SHA256 of [R2C3-fixed-loss-v1,5478,cohort,batch_index,window_ids], unchanged across checkpoints; freeze before first model call
fixed_loss.noise_plan_saved: save per-batch seeds and numeric noise hashes; regenerate identical plans, no large duplicate tensor archive
fixed_loss.loss_autocast: same fp16 model/FP32 MSE; eval mode with no backward
fixed_loss.preserve_training_RNG_and_order: capture/restore all global RNG + dedicated training noise generator; independent fixed-loss generator; preserve PreparedInputs state and mode

evaluation.paired_seed_formula: reuse unchanged R2C0 paired_seed per cohort/batch/windowIDs/step
evaluation.raw_feedback: unchanged float32; all finite out-of-range retained; no future truth/state/label in predictor
evaluation.endpoint_persistence: Use immutable raw batch/row/step indices for H1/H4, not duplicate float64 endpoint image arrays; fixed scorer receives lossless in-memory views. Public reference loader must be equivalence-checked before launch.
evaluation.shape: H1/H4 failures and unknown; preserve holes/components/fragments and occlusion unknown; never count unknown as pass
evaluation.report: per-group and per-window curves; TRAIN vs seen-val; gray and blue separate; all36H1/H4 galleries at each point; no best-seed selection

accounting.policy: append explicit C3 scope to existing v2 ledger; preserve all actual counters/history; no time gate
accounting.guard_change_reason: Old3000 was a supervisor diagnostic scope, not a user lifetime training limit; it must not truncate this explicit5700-complete continuation.
accounting.AMP_skip_policy: Observe scaler step outcome; attempted draw/cost retained, no completed update/scheduler advancement; preserve last safe full checkpoint and failure evidence, stop and report parent; no automatic retries or fabricated completion.
accounting.actual_C3_prior_ledger_SHA_and_copy: Freeze exact closed live ledger at release, after C2 callback; not a stale R1 or active C2 snapshot.
old_hardcoded_scope_sites_requiring_publ: R2C1R1ModelWorkBudget.max_attempts300 and heartbeat/reserve local stage cap
required_CPU_scope_checks: C3 stage attempt301 is allowed without resetting counters
5700 new complete updates reach lineage6000 and global6250 if no failures
old300/3000/4800 guards cannot accidentally truncate the new explicit scope
failed/AMP-skipped attempts are charged but never counted as completed

storage.baseline_reference_kind: Independent root/audit actual shared footprint before final proposal/callback; refresh again at C3 release
storage.shortage_policy: Report exact shortfall; never delete old evidence/weights or reduce to another300-update batch. No launch if full-stage reservation does not fit.
storage.logging_bound: Compact indices/IDs and numeric per-attempt/micro rows; reference frozen861-window catalogue. Do not repeat full16-window metadata at each of5700 attempts, which would exceed the16MiB compact-log budget.
storage.atomic_write_order: Sequential safe full save at each complete observation before its new evaluations. Preserve old full until verified atomic replace; no simultaneous large temp checkpoint writes. Gallery generation after model clock closed. Reserve256MiB covers temporary replacement, not another permanent full.

implementation_prerequisites: Explicit successor checkpoint/config identity preserving original R1 payload and native math; no silent restore helper bypass
Versioned continuation of the same R2C0 order beyond4800 with lossless legacy state migration and prefix/queue/RNG CPU proofs
Replace inherited per-stage300 attempt guards, R1 CLI CAPS300 and global3000 guard together with explicit5700-complete C3 scope; preserve counters and genuine failure accounting
Restore cosine state and public conditional step through3000, then hold eta_min; targeted LR boundary tests
Raw endpoint-reference loader with exact float64 metric identity equivalence; no duplicate images
Full-byte/stage/shared/atomic preflight and bounded compact logging; freeze source/config/input identities before unique run

interpretation.C2_scope: sampler dependence only at fixed300-update weights; cannot establish training sufficiency, convergence, capacity ceiling or hopeless shape fidelity
interpretation.horizontal_gain: 3-to16 improvement at a fixed training point supports a sampling factor
interpretation.longitudinal_gain: improvement with training at fixed sampler supports insufficient training at300
interpretation.both_or_neither: Report both factors or no improvement honestly; no unique-cause claim; small/ambiguous differences remain insufficient evidence
interpretation.overfit_check: TRAIN loss/metrics improve while seen-val/nearstatic/shape worsen is a retention/overfit warning, not unseen generalization evidence
interpretation.point_6000: an observation, not automatic convergence or final project completion; parent decides whether10000plus is warranted

forbidden: actual C3 execution before parent C2 acceptance/instruction
server_training: Always manually executed by the human.
